# Stellar Edu Consultancy — Public Website Knowledge Base

Last updated: 2026-09-12

## Company

Stellar Edu Consultancy is an MBBS-abroad education consultancy based in Mira Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. The website presents Stellar as an expert-led advisory for Indian students and families considering medical education abroad.

Core services include MBBS abroad counselling, country comparison, university selection support, eligibility guidance, documentation support, admissions guidance, family counselling, and practical student-life preparation.

## Doctors and counsellors

### Dr. Nishu Yadav

Founder and Lead Admissions Advisor. Public website biography says he completed medical education across Ukraine and Kazakhstan, cleared FMGE on his first attempt with a strong score, and guides students for MBBS abroad and FMGE preparation.

### Dr. Lokesh Attri

Co-Founder and FMGE Expert. Public website biography says he completed medical education across Ukraine and Kazakhstan, cleared FMGE on his first attempt with a score of 210, and guides students for FMGE and MBBS abroad decisions.

### Dr. Bindu Tyagi

Co-Founder and Admissions Advisor. Public website biography says she completed medical education at Ternopil National Medical University and guides students on MBBS abroad, FMGE preparation, safety, academics, and adapting to life overseas.

## Admissions process

The website presents the MBBS abroad journey as a structured process: consultation, profile evaluation, country and university comparison, application, documentation, admission/visa support, and arrival preparation.

## Eligibility

The website explains that Indian students generally need NEET qualification, Physics/Chemistry/Biology in Class 12, required minimum PCB percentage, and compliance with applicable NMC/FMGL requirements. Students should verify current NMC, WDOMS, university, and country-specific rules before admission.

## Verification note

All university and eligibility information is for guidance. Official recognition, eligibility, admissions, fees, and licensing rules can change. Students should verify WDOMS, NMC/FMGL, official university pages, and relevant government/regulatory sources before final admission or payment.
